name: Key check
author: countertop tests
description: Tries a tile's API keys: they reach httpbin.org only, never postman-echo.com or a redirect there, and the tile never sees them.

key.label: Test key (sent in a header)
key.help: Type anything at least 6 characters long, like test-key-123.

token.label: Test key (sent in the address)
token.help: Type anything at least 6 characters long, like test-token-456.
